name: Mask Trim Edges Before Wall Finish
intent: Apply tape and paper to baseboard tops, door casing edges, and window casing edges before wall finish coats. The wall painter cuts to this tape line with a brush. Trim package must be installed and finished prior to this module.
doctrine: Each masking task reads its own substrate-specific PS key: baseboard masking uses PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_BASEBOARD (just baseboard LF), door casing uses PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_CASING_DOOR, window casing uses PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_CASING_WINDOW. Previously all three shared the lumped PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_EDGES key, which inflated each task ~2.5-3x because TRIM_EDGES is the sum of all three substrate LFs. Fixed 2026-04-18 after McLeod project exposed a 13x18 bedroom showing 157 LF on baseboard masking when baseboard was only 62 LF.
